outcome: Sensitivity of blood cultures vs multiplex PCR for neonatal sepsis
Specificity of blood cultures vs multiplex PCR for neonatal sepsis
Positive and negative predictive values of blood cultures vs multiplex PCR for neonatal sepsis
cohort: 229 newborns at risk of neonatal sepsis.
finding: While multiplex PCR provided quicker results, it did not improve diagnostic accuracy for early onset neonatal sepsis compared to blood cultures, and had a higher false positive rate.
